========================================
        LOCALDROP - Just Scan and Send
========================================

Transfer files between your phone and PC
instantly. No internet. No cables. No app.

----------------------------------------
REQUIREMENTS
----------------------------------------
- Your phone and PC must be on the same
  WiFi network (or phone hotspot)
- Any phone browser works (Chrome, Safari)

----------------------------------------
HOW TO USE
----------------------------------------
1. Double-click LocalDrop.exe
2. A QR code opens in your browser
3. Scan the QR code with your phone camera
4. LocalDrop opens on your phone
5. Tap "Send Files" to send from phone to PC
6. Tap "Check for Files" to download from PC

Files land in: Desktop > LocalDrop Files

----------------------------------------
WINDOWS SECURITY WARNING
----------------------------------------
Windows may show "Windows protected your PC"
when you first run LocalDrop.

This is normal for apps without a paid
certificate. To run it:

1. Click "More info"
2. Click "Run anyway"

LocalDrop does not connect to the internet.
You can verify this in Task Manager.

----------------------------------------
TROUBLESHOOTING
----------------------------------------
"Cannot connect" on phone?
- Make sure phone and PC are on same WiFi
- Try turning WiFi off and on on your phone

Files not showing in "Check for Files"?
- Place files in the "LocalDrop Files"
  folder on your Desktop first

Port already in use error?
- Another app is using port 8080
- Restart your PC and try again

----------------------------------------
VERSION: 1.0.0
Built with Node.js + Express
